pricing.metaTitle: AI agent pricing from CHF 450 a month | Trident Software
pricing.metaDescription: AI agent pricing in three lines: a one-off integration fee of CHF 6,000–25,000, a monthly run fee from CHF 450, and an optional 70/30 outcome share.
pricing.label: Pricing
pricing.heroTitle: Three lines. Never one monthly figure.
pricing.heroLead: The integration fee is never buried in a monthly figure. Connecting an existing ERP, accounting system or legacy database is where projects overrun, so we quote it as its own line.

integration.text: Discovery, knowledge base build, scenario design, channel and CRM connections, testing, staff training and two weeks of supervised live running. The range is driven by the number of systems, not the number of channels.

run.amt: From CHF 450 · typical CHF 900 · full automation from CHF 1,800
run.text: Platform, hosting, monitoring, support and monthly scenario tuning. Model usage is passed through at cost with the invoice attached. We take no margin on tokens.

outcome.text: The 70/30 structure: 70 % of the value as a fixed fee, 30 % tied to a KPI agreed in writing before launch (qualified leads, bookings made, response time held under target). Where the effect is measurable and attribution is clean, we take 15–25 % of the verified annual saving instead of a flat fee, capped and reviewed quarterly. If your CRM cannot attribute a booking to a channel, a flat fee is the fair structure and we will say so.

pricing.exampleLead: Illustrative model, not a client result. The point is the shape of the calculation, not these particular figures.
effects: Routine volume absorbed: 0.8 FTE redeployed, not dismissed
Out-of-hours enquiries now answered: 140 a month, at half the normal close rate
Faster first response on in-hours enquiries: 2 pp close-rate lift
pricing.payback: Against a one-off integration fee of CHF 12,000, payback lands in month two.
pricing.assumptions: Read the assumptions before you read the total. Two of them do the heavy lifting: that out-of-hours enquiries convert at half the in-hours rate, and that redeployed capacity turns into revenue rather than slack. In the audit we replace both with your measured numbers, and we show you the version where they come out worse. A calculator tuned to produce a headline is a sales tool, not a business case.
pricing.referencesText: We do not publish other companies' results as our own, and we do not name clients without written permission. The figures on this page are labelled as models, because that is what they are. In the audit you get the same model filled with your data, and the file is yours to keep.

about.heroLead: Founded in 2009 in Kharkiv, Ukraine, and incorporated in Sion, Valais, in 2022, Trident Software builds custom software, AI systems, and embedded solutions for European SMEs. Senior engineers only. Fixed budgets. Compliance included.
about.storyIntro: Trident was born from frustration with agencies that overpromise and underdeliver. We set out to build a company where senior engineers own the outcome end-to-end.
about.storyP1: We started in Kharkiv, Ukraine in 2009 with two engineers and a conviction: great software requires great engineers who stay on the project from kickoff to deployment. No handoffs, no junior substitutions, no feature factories.
about.storyP2: Over 15 years we've delivered 100+ projects across automotive, healthcare, logistics, fashion, and SaaS, and today we build AI into the production systems our clients run on.
about.storyP3: Today we work from Sion and Geneva, with senior engineers who share the same standards: clean architecture, observable systems, and honest timelines.

labour.title: 1. Direct labour
labour.text: Hours per week spent on repetitive enquiries × loaded hourly cost. A single inside-sales FTE at CHF 90,000–120,000 loaded spends 4–6 hours a day on conversations an agent handles in full.

revenue.title: 2. Lost revenue
revenue.text: Enquiries that arrive outside office hours × your close rate × average deal value. This is usually the larger of the three and the one companies have never measured, because unanswered enquiries leave no trace in the CRM.

errors.title: 3. Cost of errors
errors.text: Wrong quote, missed booking, forgotten follow-up, the no-show that no one confirmed. Priced at the gross margin lost, not the revenue.

Individual project agreements (Statements of Work) take precedence over these GTC where they conflict.

what.title: What are cookies?
what.body: Cookies are small text files stored on your device by your browser when you visit a website. They help the site remember your preferences and understand how you use it.

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.body: We measure how the site is used with Umami, a privacy-focused analytics tool. It loads only after you accept analytics in the cookie banner, and it sets no cookies. If you decline, it does not load. We do not use Google Analytics or similar third-party services.
